cell.label: All patients with type 2 diabetes: smoking cessation; blood pressure control (<140/90, possibly <130/80); lipid lowering with a moderate- or high-intensity statin; metformin (independent of blood sugars, especially if obese)
Strongly consider aspirin (if cardiovascular disease and at low risk of bleeding) and an ACE inhibitor (even if normotensive)
Additional treatment goal: reasonable blood glucose control

footnotes.footnote: Abbreviations: ACE, angiotensin-converting enzyme; LDL, low-density lipoprotein.
